changes: One persistent visible search instruction asks for a process, screen, setting or routine and is associated with the search input. Ranking bytes, topic/source payloads, questions and expected results are unchanged. All 725 actual current HTTP result payloads exactly match the immediate prior base.
remaining_limit: All 39 raw misses and earlier historical regressions remain preserved. Diagnostic context labels do not relabel misses as passes or establish that all questions are inherently unanswerable. Authored regression checks are not independent semantic or intended-user acceptance.

diagnosis.scope: Independent verification of 39 frozen authored misses and four bounded offline alternatives; no ranking alternative deployed.

cases.question: Does the routine return five result sets?
cases.diagnosis: The routine is unnamed; many routines discuss result sets. The expected topic has a fifth-result exclusion, whereas the question uses five.

cases.question: Does a profile select one deterministic detail row?
cases.diagnosis: Profile/detail-row selection appears in multiple reviewed configuration topics. The question omits work execution. Its matching concepts are spread across the answer and routine detail.

cases.question: Does an error guarantee all earlier changes are rolled back?
cases.diagnosis: No adjustment, routine or operation is named. Rollback and caller-transaction limits apply to many distinct reviewed operations.

cases.question: Can two identical warehouse filters prove the same result?
cases.diagnosis: Warehouse filters identify a broad mechanism, but not the work-type chart/work-group drilldown. Exact-word matching improves this question and regresses others.

cases.question: Does no row mean zero work?
cases.diagnosis: Work is named, but not the indicator tile or selector. No-row/zero distinctions exist across many work helpers. Process-work gets an explicit-name priority.

cases.question: Is this always one atomic operation?
cases.diagnosis: This and operation do not identify deactivation, work or inactive storage. Many reviewed operations have conditional atomicity.

cases.question: Does reservation prove stock left?
cases.diagnosis: Reservation versus physical stock is meaningful, but uses stock left rather than indexed on-hand/allocated terminology. Several returned allocation/inventory topics are relevant competitors.

cases.question: Does archival prove commit?
cases.diagnosis: Archival does not identify empty source inventory or the movement caller. Archive/commit limitations are shared by many reviewed routines.

cases.question: Can the header status only advance?
cases.diagnosis: Header status is named, but not ship confirmation or the shipment header. Many inbound/outbound status helpers compete.

cases.question: Can an arbitrary alphanumeric ID pass through unchanged?
cases.diagnosis: An arbitrary alphanumeric ID does not identify receipt-container generation. The indexed explanation uses numeric conversion rather than the complete question vocabulary.

cases.question: Does NULL mean status zero?
cases.diagnosis: NULL/status-zero semantics are common to multiple status functions; the action-to-status lookup is unnamed.

cases.question: Are all steps serialized by this gate?
cases.diagnosis: This gate has no supplied name or wave context. Porter stems serialized to serial, allowing unrelated serial-number passages to compete.

cases.question: Does active mean the worker is alive?
cases.diagnosis: Active and worker do not identify the active-wave list or dialog routines. The source describes a last-step predicate rather than worker liveness.

cases.question: Does the helper reserve more stock?
cases.diagnosis: The helper is unnamed; reserving stock fits many allocation/inventory helpers. The expected topic is about conversion selection.

cases.question: Does no row return 0 and100 automatically?
cases.diagnosis: No capacity, replenishment or function is named. The concatenated and100 is already split into and and 100 by the existing tokenizer.

cases.question: What if both branch counts equal three?
cases.diagnosis: Both branch counts is mathematically meaningful but names no process/function. The source UNION equal-count behavior is present; exact-word matching substantially changes its rank.

cases.question: Are these settings confirmed for the current warehouse?
cases.diagnosis: These settings has no setting names or QC subject. Many source-limit passages correctly say current warehouse settings are not established.

cases.question: Does one failed shipment roll back the entire wave automatically?
cases.diagnosis: Shipment and wave are named, but container numbering is not. Many independent wave operations discuss failure/rollback.

cases.question: Does In Process prevent a second claimant?
cases.diagnosis: In Process identifies a shared status phrase, without upload/batch identity. Other process-state guidance competes.

cases.question: Will the serial helper skip records from a previous run?
cases.diagnosis: Serial helper omits upload staging identity. Several serial copy/archive helpers and previous-run behaviors compete.

cases.question: Does UNION preserve every physical source row?
cases.diagnosis: UNION semantics are explicit but do not identify the interface view family. The top result view-retained-unions also directly addresses UNION row preservation.

cases.question: Is NULL same as default zero?
cases.diagnosis: NULL/default/zero has no function or status-slot identity. Many defaulting contracts differ, so selecting one silently would invent context.

cases.question: Are all no-match outputs0?
cases.diagnosis: No quantity or function is named. Existing tokens split outputs0 correctly; numeric zero and word zero remain lexically distinct.

cases.question: Does text prove every value is present?
cases.diagnosis: Text/every value does not identify bounded report-string helpers, serial/BOL lists or the output limit.

cases.question: Does missing shipment always returnNULL?
cases.diagnosis: Missing shipment is broad; BOL ordinal/stop helper is unnamed. Existing tokenizer already splits returnNULL into return and null.

cases.question: Are work date windows always a full local calendar day?
cases.diagnosis: Work/date-window/local-day question has meaningful content supported by the dashboard explanation. Relevant terms span passages and calendar helpers compete.

cases.question: Does percentage0 always mean no work processed?
cases.diagnosis: Percentage-zero/work identifies a broad metric, but not the dashboard/KPI. Existing tokenizer splits percentage0; several work metrics discuss zero.

cases.question: Do retained table references mean archive jobs ran during this review?
cases.diagnosis: Retained table references and archive jobs identify an evidence limit common across retained-source views, rather than a unique view family.

cases.question: Must minimum component item and minimum line ID come from one component?
cases.diagnosis: Independent minimum component fields is specific and source-supported. The question omits work order; competing component topics and process-item priority displace rank ten. C7 already clarified prose; no repeated prose edit is justified here.

cases.question: Do two serial rows necessarily mean two separate inventory balances?
cases.diagnosis: Serial rows versus inventory balances is specific, source-supported and competes with several genuinely relevant inventory/serial explanations.

cases.question: Is total ordered quantity net of allocation?
cases.diagnosis: Total ordered quantity versus allocation is specific and source-supported. Porter/lexical ranking and many quantity aggregates affect its rank.

cases.question: What can a missing selected separator cause?
cases.diagnosis: The selected separator is unnamed and no file/document/path context is supplied. The expected explanation is present, and tokenizer choice changes competing matches.

cases.question: Does a successful first stage guarantee the full batch?
cases.diagnosis: First stage/full batch names no download operation. Many independent batch/transaction workflows have similar success limitations.

cases.question: Does receipt selection prove upload delivered?
cases.diagnosis: Receipt selection versus upload delivery is meaningful, but several receipt/upload topics already explain the same boundary. C7 clarified this answer; no repeated prose edit is justified.

cases.question: Is its source the captured local shipment table?
cases.diagnosis: Its source supplies no report name; local shipment table is insufficient to identify the external fixed report.

cases.question: Should every returned item be automatically corrected or written off?
cases.diagnosis: Every returned item does not identify the inventory diagnostic or finding. Corrected/written off are not a unique process identity.

cases.question: Does a NULL stored override always remain NULL?
cases.diagnosis: Stored override is shared terminology without accessorial/shipment/carrier identity. Many NULL/default contracts compete.

cases.question: Does shipment-detail fallback use internal shipment number?
cases.diagnosis: Shipment-detail fallback/internal shipment number identifies a meaningful lookup distinction, but does not name export fields. Incidental shipment-detail topic-ID priority and strong competing shipment topics affect ranking.

cases.question: Can a missing container still produce display rows?
cases.diagnosis: Missing container/display rows names no screen or close-container model. Several container presentation models can return default rows.

diagnosis.interpretation: Classification is a diagnostic judgment about supplied context, not an answerability score. Seven specific semantic questions remain retrieval shortcomings; broad and omitted-subject questions still retain their original miss metric. Alternatives tested do not establish an exhaustive search for a better ranker.
